question: What parental role does the mātṛkā hold for all mantra-knowledges?
premises: All mantra-knowledges are included in scope
Mātṛkā is called both father and mother
Mātṛkā is identified as their source
inference: The mātṛkā is the dual parental source of all mantra-knowledges
plain_english: The mātṛkā is both father and mother of all mantra-knowledges.
